::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 29 1896  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/60/228
:::

Dear Madam
It appears that the three houses occupied by the County Police, [Mrs Jewell](people/person_767.qmd) & [Mrs Light](people/person_2149.qmd) are additional to the list I sent you, & are not insured  I am sorry to trouble you again but if you will let me know the materials with which these three are built & covered I will add them to the insurance Policy at £100 each & the whole matter will then be in order

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Miss Yonge
